claims.statement: DTV dependents are limited to a legal spouse and unmarried children under 20, with no cap on the number of qualifying dependents.
Each dependent submits a separate DTV application and pays a separate 10,000 THB embassy fee.
Dependents can technically apply at the same time as the main holder at some embassies, though sequential filing after main approval avoids risking multiple non-refundable fees.
